reason: I keep feeding creators for free and I honestly don't know if a single customer walks in because of them, so if it's just a WhatsApp link and a PIN with no app, I'll try it while it's free. If the evening message shows nothing, at least I know to stop giving away meals.
objection: At lunch rush I'm alone at the counter; I won't have time to type PINs on customers' phones or write codes on bills, and half the creators I deal with won't bother sending me the link anyway.
